seeding.SEEDING_MAP_SLOT_INVALID: This stage's seeding map has an invalid position. Fix the seeding rules and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_MAP_SOURCE_INVALID: This stage's seeding map points to a qualifier that doesn't exist. Fix the seeding rules and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_MAP_SOURCE_AMBIGUOUS: This stage's seeding map points to a qualifier that exists in more than one place. Fix the seeding rules and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_RULES_MISSING: This stage has no seeding rules, or its generated fixtures no longer match them. Add seeding rules, or regenerate this stage's fixtures.
seeding.SEEDING_SOURCE_INCOMPLETE: The source stage isn't finished yet. Complete it before computing this proposal.
seeding.SEEDING_BESTNTH_UNEQUAL_POOLS: These groups have played different numbers of games, so their standings can't be compared yet.
seeding.SEEDING_ALREADY_CONFIRMED: This stage's slots are already filled from a confirmed proposal.
seeding.SEEDING_PROPOSAL_STALE: Standings changed since this proposal was computed. Recompute it to see the current qualifiers.
seeding.SEEDING_EDIT_UNKNOWN_SLOT: One of your edits refers to a slot this proposal doesn't have. Recompute the proposal and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_TIE_UNRESOLVED: Resolve every tied slot before confirming — pick which entrant fills each one.
seeding.SEEDING_SLOT_DOUBLE_ASSIGNED: The same entrant is assigned to more than one slot. Fix your edits and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_ENTRANT_FOREIGN: One of the qualifying entrants no longer belongs to this division.
seeding.SEEDING_ENTRANT_WITHDRAWN: One of the qualifying entrants has withdrawn. Recompute the proposal to see who is left — their place in the draw stays empty.
seeding.SEEDING_SLOT_FOREIGN_FIXTURE: One of the destination slots belongs to a different stage. Recompute the proposal and try again.
seeding.SEEDING_FIXTURES_ALREADY_FILLED: One of the destination slots is already filled. Recompute the proposal to see what's left.
seeding.SEEDING_CARRY_SOURCE_INVALID: Carry-over needs a source stage with a points table — a league, group or Swiss stage. A knockout, ladder or Americano stage hands the next stage a finishing order rather than points, so there is nothing to carry over. Turn carry-over off for this stage, or source it from a league, group or Swiss stage.
schedule.SCHEDULE_OUTSIDE_COMPETITION.be: This division's schedule starts before the competition opens on {startsOn}. Widen the competition dates, or bring the division inside them.
schedule.SCHEDULE_OUTSIDE_COMPETITION.af: This division's schedule ends after the competition closes on {endsOn}. Widen the competition dates, or bring the division inside them.
schedule.SCHEDULE_OUTSIDE_COMPETITION.bo: This division's schedule starts before the competition opens on {startsOn} and ends after it closes on {endsOn}. Widen the competition dates, or bring the division inside them.
schedule.SCHEDULE_COURT_STILL_IN_USE.pin: Cannot remove a court that still holds pinned fixtures: {courtsDetail}. Unpin them or reschedule them before removing the court.
schedule.SCHEDULE_COURT_STILL_IN_USE.fix: Cannot remove a court that still holds fixtures the schedule can't move: {courtsDetail}. They're already completed, so there's nothing to unpin or reschedule. To stop scheduling new matches on this court, archive it from the venue Directory instead of removing it here.
schedule.SCHEDULE_COURT_STILL_IN_USE.inP: Cannot remove a court with a fixture still in play: {courtsDetail}. A live match can't be unpinned, rescheduled, or archived away — wait for it to finish, then try again.
schedule.SCHEDULE_COURT_STILL_IN_USE.mix: Cannot remove a court that still holds fixtures the schedule can't move: {courtsDetail}. Unpin any pinned fixtures and wait for live matches to finish; once only completed fixtures remain, archive the court from the venue Directory instead of removing it here.
